brief.headline: Memory Supercycle Extends Into Q2 with HBM Pricing Reigniting; Samsung-SK Hynix Spread Tightest on Record
brief.summary: <cite index="10-2,10-7">DRAM contract prices surged 58–63% QoQ in Q2 2026 while NAND jumped 70–75% QoQ, following Q1's historic 90–95% DRAM gains.</cite> <cite index="1-3">Samsung and SK Hynix raised HBM3E supply prices ~20% for 2026 deliveries amid resurgent demand from Nvidia H200 China shipments, Google TPU, and Amazon Trainium.</cite> <cite index="27-5,28-2">Hyperscaler capex is now tracking to $602B in 2026 (+36% YoY), with ~75% ($450B) earmarked for AI infrastructure.</cite> <cite index="26-3,26-5">SK Hynix market cap reached 93.2% of Samsung's (gap: 119 trillion won) on Friday, though Samsung jumped 5.84% Saturday on HBM4E sample news; YTD gains stand at +258.4% SK Hynix vs +164.4% Samsung.</cite> <cite index="22-3,22-5">KOSPI hit record 8,788.38 (+3.68%) driven by single-stock leveraged ETF buying of Samsung and SK Hynix shares, with AUM reaching 5.95 trillion won.</cite>
brief.pair_trade_view: Spread compression to 119T won (93.2% ratio) argues for near-term mean reversion favoring Samsung, especially post-HBM4E sample catalyst Saturday. But structural momentum favors SK Hynix: <cite index="2-12">UBS forecasts ~70% HBM4 market share for SK Hynix in Nvidia Rubin 2026.</cite> <cite index="25-15">200+ Samsung engineers moved to SK Hynix in four months through Feb 2026, signaling compensation/execution gap.</cite> <cite index="18-3">Goldman projects 2028 OP: Samsung 610T won vs SK Hynix 454T won, but upward revisions larger for SK Hynix (+21–23% for '27/'28).</cite> Tactical long Samsung vs SK Hynix for 1–2 week snap, but reverse to structural long SK Hynix if Samsung HBM4E qual at Nvidia stalls or if <cite index="26-16">Hana Securities' bull-market-top warning (SK Hynix overtaking Samsung cap) triggers profit-taking.</cite>

memory_cycle.notes: <cite index="2-3">BofA defines 2026 as supercycle, forecasting DRAM revenue +51% YoY, NAND +45% YoY, with ASPs rising 33% and 26% respectively.</cite> <cite index="12-17">Top-8 hyperscaler capex projected to exceed $600B in 2026 (+40% YoY).</cite> <cite index="10-9,10-10">Suppliers reallocating capacity to AI/server DRAM and enterprise SSDs; cloud providers securing long-term agreements; meaningful capacity expansion not until late 2027.</cite> <cite index="6-15">KB Securities projects 2026 HBM revenue mix: 55% HBM4, 45% HBM3E, with HBM4 meaningfully absorbing HBM3E demand only post-Q3.</cite> Cycle durability supported by <cite index="12-5">analyst projections that memory price rally extends past 2028.</cite>

brief.hbm_pulse: <cite index="6-1,6-5">Samsung and SK Hynix raised HBM3E prices ~20% recently, following sharp order increases from Nvidia and custom ASIC designers.</cite> <cite index="6-11,6-12,6-13">Nvidia H200 China export resumption triggered renewed HBM3E demand; HBM4 transition preparations paradoxically tightening HBM3E supply as manufacturers concentrate resources on next-gen.</cite> <cite index="7-2,7-6">April 2026 pricing reference: HBM3E ~$300/36GB stack, HBM4 ~$500/48GB stack.</cite> <cite index="4-1">Goldman report indicates Samsung HBM3E priced 5% below SK Hynix; Samsung may cut further to regain share, with HBM3E prices expected to decline 28% YoY in 2026 ($15/GB to $10/GB) under competitive pressure.</cite> <cite index="2-7,2-8">BofA estimates 2026 HBM market at $54.6B (+58% YoY); Goldman forecasts HBM demand for ASIC chips to skyrocket 82%, accounting for one-third of market.</cite>

news_pulse.headline: Goldman Sachs raises Samsung + SK Hynix 2028 OP forecasts above 1T won combined; cites 'Higher for Longer' memory supercycle
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="18-2,18-3">Goldman projects Samsung 2028 OP 610T won, SK Hynix 454T won, citing HBM demand + commodity memory boom lasting longer than anticipated; 2027/2028 estimates raised 21–23%.</cite> Validates supercycle thesis, supports sustained multiple expansion.

news_pulse.headline: Jensen Huang Korea visit (second 'kkanbu meeting') imminent; Samsung/SK Hynix seen as top beneficiaries per Hana Securities
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="19-8,19-9">Hana: SK Hynix/Samsung hold HBM bottleneck; last Huang visit (Oct) drove SK Hynix +22%, Samsung +6.3% in 12 days.</cite> Potential near-term catalyst for momentum continuation, especially if HBM4/Rubin roadmap updates disclosed.

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix market cap reaches 93.2% of Samsung; gap narrows to record-low 119T won; Hana warns reversal could signal bull market top
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="26-2,26-3,26-16">Gap hit 119.5T won Friday (SK Hynix +2.05%, Samsung -2.44%); Hana researcher warns SK Hynix overtaking Samsung could signal bull market ending, citing 2000 Cisco/MSFT analog.</cite> Contrarian risk flag; watch for capitulation if spread inverts.

news_pulse.headline: Samsung jumped 5.84% Saturday on world-first HBM4E sample shipment news; market cap gap widened back to ~190T won
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="26-4">Samsung became first to ship HBM4E (7th-gen HBM) samples, returning gap to 190T won.</cite> Temporary Samsung catch-up narrative; durability hinges on Nvidia qual progress vs SK Hynix HBM4 ramp.

news_pulse.headline: KOSPI surges 3.68% to record 8,788.38; single-stock leveraged ETFs on Samsung/SK Hynix drive institutional buying
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="22-3,22-5,22-16,22-17,22-18">KOSPI within 2.4% of 9,000; leveraged ETF operators' spot demand concentrating institutional buying; single-stock leverage AUM 5.95T won, Samsung ETF +20% Tuesday.</cite> Technical tailwind but leverage-driven flow fragile; vol spike risk if profit-taking accelerates.

news_pulse.headline: Samsung, SK Hynix leveraged ETFs drew 28T won in 3 days; SK Hynix products returned up to 28.27%
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="20-1,20-14,20-15">16 single-stock leverage/inverse ETFs traded 27.9T won Nov 27–29; retail bought 9.2T won, sold 5.2T won (55.9% turnover).</cite> Retail momentum chase; high turnover suggests fragile hands, amplifies downside risk on negative news.

news_pulse.headline: Hyperscaler 2026 capex estimates raised to $600–725B; 75% AI infrastructure; Amazon ~$200B, Microsoft $110–120B, Meta $125–145B
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="27-5,28-2,32-6">Big 5 hyperscalers projected $602–725B capex in 2026 (+36–62% YoY), ~75% ($450B) AI-specific.</cite> <cite index="32-8">Meta raised 2026 capex to $125–145B due to higher component pricing + data center costs.</cite> Structural demand support for HBM/DRAM/NAND, but component inflation flags margin pressure risk downstream.

news_pulse.headline: TSMC CoWoS capacity fully booked through 2026; CoWoS-L/S at max; Nvidia secured >60% allocation; expansion to 130k wpm by end-2026
news_pulse.implication: <cite index="39-2,39-6">TSMC CoWoS-L/S fully booked by Nvidia, Google, Amazon, MediaTek orders.</cite> <cite index="37-8,37-9">TSMC scaling CoWoS from 35k wpm late-2024 to 130k wpm by end-2026; Nvidia holds >60% 2025/26 capacity.</cite> CoWoS remains choke point; any TSMC yield/geopolitical disruption disproportionately hurts Nvidia → cascades to HBM pull-in risk for Samsung/SK Hynix.

brief.derivatives_signal: <cite index="20-10,20-11,20-18">KODEX SK Hynix leverage ranked #1 ETF by 3-day volume (10.9T won); combined single-stock leverage AUM 5.95T won.</cite> <cite index="20-13,20-14,20-15">Retail bought 9.2T won, sold 5.2T won over 3 days (55.9% turnover), signaling short-term gain-locking behavior.</cite> Gamma/delta dynamics from leveraged ETF rebalancing amplifying intraday vol; any -5% Samsung/SK Hynix session could trigger cascade as ETF operators deleverage. <cite index="20-20,20-21,20-22">Concerns emerging on single-stock ETF concentration amplifying volatility; pre-trading education applicants surged from 100k to 330k post-listing.</cite> Retail euphoria flag; fade strength on 2–3% intraday gaps.
watch_for_next_3h: Samsung HBM4E Nvidia qualification status update or leak; any pushback to Q3 would reopen SK Hynix spread
Hyperscaler earnings commentary (if any June guidance updates) on H2 AI capex pacing or memory component cost inflation
Korean media reports on Jensen Huang Korea visit agenda/timing; HBM4/Rubin supply chain MOU announcements
TSMC CoWoS utilization or yield issues in Taiwan supply chain press; geopolitical headline risk (Taiwan Strait, export controls)
Single-stock leveraged ETF daily rebalance flows into close; watch for accelerated selling if KOSPI momentum stalls near 9,000
